newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down as correction continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down as correction continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended down as a market correction continued for a third day, brokers said.
The benchmark index of Dhaka Stock Exchange fell 85.96 points or 2.75 percent at 3,390.92. Turnover was 260.3 million taka. Of the 120 issues traded, 105 lost and 15 gained.

Brokers said the market was under normal correction process, but political tension over the opposition's parliament boycott also made investors shaky. Shine Pukur Holdings retained status as volume leader with 116,550 scrips traded at 665.10 taka each, up 32.62 taka, while Beximco Pharma shed 13.48 to 440.34.
